parameters.name: IsPoc
parameters.description: Specifies whether the service is a trial service.

parameters.name: NetworkRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the virtual Internet.

parameters.name: PrivateVpcConnectionMode
parameters.description: The connection mode. Valid values: \`PrivateLink\` and \`OverlayLink\`. \`OverlayLink\` is an overlay link that is based on Application-aware Network Service Mesh (ANSM).

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description: The service ID. This parameter is used with the \`IsPoc\` parameter when \`IsPoc\` is set to \`true\`.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceEndpointServiceType
parameters.description: The direction of the internal-facing access. Valid values: \`Forward\` and \`Reverse\`.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description: The region where the service is deployed.

parameters.name: ServiceVersion
parameters.description: The service version. This parameter is used with the \`IsPoc\` parameter when \`IsPoc\` is set to \`true\`.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone where the service is deployed.
